about: S07.7 (D.21): the machine-readable registry of the Block D retention and deletion policy. docs/operations/FAMILY-DATA-RETENTION.md is the written policy; agent/tools/check-block-d-retention.mjs keeps this file, the migration family_data_retention, Core's constants (backend/src/services/familyRetention.ts), the family-facing copy and the nightly jobs equal, and fails when a Block D table exists without a class here.

evidence.anchor: the Tutor's decision on the chore
evidence.action: the photo is deleted from Depot, then the chore's pointer is cleared

records.anchor: the named timestamp of each row

invites.action: the whole row (and its token) is deleted

research.action: the snapshot is deleted; every snapshot is deleted at once on a no

account.action: kept while the account exists and deleted with it

publicAnswers.why: S07.8: D.21 asks for the policy to be published; the marketing FAQ states the photo and record periods to anyone, and must never drift from the periods the nightly job enforces.

tasks.rule: an approved or cancelled chore, 400 days after the decision, once its photo is gone

family_decisions.rule: every decision and its reason, 400 days after it was made

redemptions.rule: a denied reward request 400 days after the decision; a fulfilled one 400 days after it was given

family_autonomy_requests.rule: an answered level request, 400 days after the answer

family_autonomy_changes.rule: a level change and its reason, 400 days after it

family_autonomy_eligibility_log.rule: 400 days after the first eligible day

family_talk_nudges.rule: a closed nudge, 400 days after it closed

family_denial_reason_scores.rule: a human score of a reason, 400 days after scoring

family_state_audit.rule: a state transition, 400 days after it
family_state_audit.note: Opaque ids and states only (no name, note or amount); after an erasure its ids resolve to nothing, and the row is deleted within 400 days.

share_gifts.rule: a settled Share gift and its note, 400 days after it was settled

wallet_guardian_actions.rule: a Tutor's coin correction and its reason, 400 days after it (the ledger line stays)

goal_next_steps.rule: an answered next-goal prompt, 400 days after the answer

parent_coaching_deliveries.rule: a delivered tip, 400 days after its month

family_decision_reflections.rule: whether the reflective prompt was answered, 400 days after the decision (no text is ever stored)

family_money_events.rule: a consent-gated behaviour event, 400 days after it

staff_insight_checks.rule: a staff insight health check, 400 days after it
staff_insight_checks.note: Closed vocabularies and times only; no identity.

family_retention_runs.rule: a retention run's counts, 400 days after it ran

guardian_invites.rule: an invitation 30 days after it was used or expired

family_research_snapshots.rule: a monthly snapshot 1,100 days after its month; all of a participant's at once on a no

wallet_ledger.rule: the coin record the balances are computed from

wallet_self_actions.rule: a teen's logged income and marked rewards (part of the coin record)

banking_accounts.rule: the practice card, its name and its freeze

savings_bonus_explanations.rule: whether the teen's worked example was answered

redemption_catalog.rule: the Tutor's reward list (deleted with the Tutor who wrote it)

chore_streak_days.rule: practised days, kept so the best streak and total are never erased (D.2)

chore_streak_pauses.rule: holiday pauses, kept because past streaks are computed with them (D.2)

guardian_links.rule: the family link and its lifecycle (pending, verified, rejected, revoked)

money_bridge_progress.rule: the teen's own bridge checklist (no amount, bank or account detail)

family_research_consents.rule: every research yes and no, the record of consent

family_research_participants.rule: the random research id, deleted on a no together with every snapshot
